limitations: The live trial covers the requested deepseek/deepseek-chat model alias and three synthetic tasks. The adapter did not expose an immutable provider revision. This result does not generalize to all models or tasks.

rollback: Disable the affected capabilities through Settings, revoke active native and browser grants, and disconnect affected remote devices before reverting. Preserve user data, durable job receipts, and all qualification reports. Requalify any revised public prompt or fixture suite.
